list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task here — it is the reward for finishing everything else. Expect the full run to take around 200 hours, with the story alone taking 60 to 80 of those. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide (roadmap).

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the game's opening mission, so this trophy is the first one most players earn — just play through the opening until the mission-complete screen appears. It cannot be missed, and it is a good moment to learn the driving and the WAiNK scanner (hold Up, then R1), because scanning the vehicles you pass already counts toward the Whip It Good trophy later. There is no way to fail it permanently: the story always moves forward from here. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 1 and this trophy pops when the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the one thing in the game that may be missable: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept to meditate with her. Chapter 1 also introduces Kenton, whose shipwreck strand starts here, and Cal, who texts you a fishing spot after the mission Feng Shui. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2's main missions and the trophy unlocks at the chapter's end. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: the mission Coffee Break unlocks free-roaming with your partner, and after it you can join a gym, buy garages through the Vice City Real Estate app, and start Bret's hunting quests. Do the optional missions as they appear — many feed the 100% checklist and later trophies, and there is no mission replay to go back with. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3's main missions, including The Cartel Heist, and the trophy pops at the chapter close. Chapter 3 is a turning point: the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs unlocks the Key Cloner, which opens Randy's sports-car wishlist, the showroom heist for Capital Offense, and more. It also starts Lucia's strand with Andy in Belville and Jason's strand with Tyrone, so follow the new character icons as they appear. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4's main missions — Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown among them — and the trophy unlocks when the chapter ends. By Chapter 4 the optional bank-vault jobs from That's Where The Money Is are available, and they are worth doing now: they count toward Maximum Withdrawal, and the 4-star wanted level there also earns Hot Together. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter, since there is no mission replay. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Chapter 5 and this gold trophy pops, closing the story. The game has five chapters and no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of Chapter 5 in case you want to revisit the endgame. Finishing the story is not the end of the run: free-roam continues, the 100% checklist unlocks at Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and most of the remaining trophies are earned after the credits. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 story mission Breakfast Run. It is one of the early missions of the second chapter, so just follow the pink main-mission icons on the map and the trophy pops when the mission ends. Like every story trophy it is automatic and unmissable — but treat each story mission as a prompt to check the map for optional missions, which feed the 100% checklist later. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission, and the trophy unlocks on mission completion. It is the chapter's big heist, so expect a longer mission with several stages — follow the objectives and it pops at the end, with nothing to miss. Chapter 3 around it is dense with unlocks, including the Key Cloner and new character strands, so clear the side content that opens up before moving on. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Child's Play. It is a main-mission trophy, so it pops automatically when the mission ends — follow the pink mission markers and there is nothing extra to do. Chapter 4 is also when the bank-vault jobs and gang operations pick up, so use the missions around it to start those counts toward Maximum Withdrawal and Pest Control. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission Headliners and the trophy unlocks at the mission's end. Story trophies like this one are automatic, so the only work is reaching the mission by playing through Chapter 4's main missions in order. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: with no mission replay, a save is the only way back if you want to redo a Chapter 4 mission later. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story mission VCIA Takedown, which takes place at Vice City International Airport. The trophy pops when the mission ends, and it is automatic — just follow the story missions to reach it. While you are at the airport, learn the layout: the same terminals are where you later steal a passenger plane for Catch Me If You Can, so knowing the gates and the boarding bridges saves time. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 story mission, and the trophy pops on completion. It is one of the last story missions before the finale, so by now the story is nearly done and the 100% checklist is about to unlock. After it, finish the final mission for the gold story trophy, then use free-roam to start the cleanup steps: collectibles, activities, robberies and the stranger strands. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game checklist, which appears after the story at Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Note it is only about 60% true completion: you need any 100 of the 200-plus optional missions, any 70 of 80 challenges, and full marks only for robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts of any kind: there are 397 in total — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge passes, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Track your count at Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and find spots on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball (score a hoop), playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check what is left at Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.target: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, 12 locations
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges spread across 12 locations. Practice each range until you know its target pattern, and remember that range time also raises your Focus level, which helps the Gunslinger trophy. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — there are 42 races in total, so you only need one win per location. Learn each course's tight turns before racing flat out, and retry a location until the win lands. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.target: Win at 20 of 40 unique race locations
trophies.guide: Win races at 20 different locations out of the 40 unique race spots in the game. Each location only counts once, so move on to a fresh location after each win instead of repeating a course you like. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you a fishing spot, marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge it leads to. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.target: Finish all levels of any one of 4 arcade games
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one arcade game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are played on the home TV with controllers, while Bang For Your Buck runs on arcade machines. Pick the game whose levels suit you best and clear it in one go. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play Lucia only, in Chapter 3: Andy calls you, then texts an address in Belville. His strand is 5 quests — Climbing the Cellerichain Parts 1 to 3, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the trophy pops on the last one. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton is auto-marked in Chapter 1; after Island Dreams he calls and his green KR icon appears at Key Lento. Dive 7 shipwrecks for treasure with the metal detector, tracking progress at Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees. He goes quiet after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2 to 3 — calling Brian as Jason speeds it up. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, head to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Billy's strand is 5 quests — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — and the trophy pops on the final one. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger strands — but only some strangers count. Confirmed counting strands are Kirk (Skunk Ape), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street races) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile); Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS unlocks the Key Cloner, steal the Zorrusso for Randy, then deliver the 16 sports cars on his wishlist — his green RK icon is in west Vice City, and the list is tracked at Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. Scan cars with WAiNK to check them, deliver in good condition for more pay, and look for them around east Vice City, Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play Jason only, after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple Synthetic Labs markers appear in Vice City. Destroy the labs in Take Out Kitty Litter, then play the quest Spin On This for the trophy. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations — and do the first one in Chapter 1, because it may be missable. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning (she says she is going to meditate), follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. Meditating as both Jason and Lucia counts twice per spot, the last meditation needs both characters together (after Chapter 2, Coffee Break), and progress is tracked at Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide and GTABase.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, Jason gets a text from Bret Vogel; his first quest is Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. Take the hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 from the weapon lockers at Ammu-Nation and hunt the unique animal he marks. Note that all 15 Target Decks are needed for 100% completion. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets in the game. Cards are found across Leonida, so pick up every set you pass while doing other content — you only need 3 for this trophy, though 15 are needed for 100% completion. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It (hold Up, then R1) at 100 locations: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures count toward it. Scan anything interesting as you travel — the app logs each new spot, and the total builds up naturally across the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges, tracked at Progress, then Challenges. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and more, so most of them progress while you play normally — check the list and chase the ones closest to done. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2, Coffee Break, you can free-roam with your partner (call them with hold Right plus Triangle). Build a 4-star wanted level together, then escape: the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a reliable hiding spot, and the trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone. It also comes automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, whose bank vaults give a 4-star wanted level. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Chapter 2, Coffee Break, rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while staying wanted — keep the flashing red and blue wanted state, not the red heat zone. Bring an armor vest and sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation, plus Zombix or Adrenaline to heal. A good run is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City (after Chapter 3, Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs): loot the items and the back-room safe with sticky bombs, and the trophy pops about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop — if it does not, hit a fourth. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with WAiNK (hold Up, look at the vehicle, hold R1) — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive them. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and progress is tracked at Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus (L3 plus R3 while aiming) to slow time, then take down 5 enemies in that single use. It drains the purple focus bar, so top it up first with food and drinks, washing your face or showering, or Adrenaline (L1 plus Triangle). Gang operations are the best place to try it, with an assault rifle such as the Duke 556 — it does not work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, raised via shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA — gates E3 and E4 are the easiest. Get in through the stairs by the boarding bridge or on foot through the terminal, climb to the cockpit upstairs, reverse out to the airstrip and take off, then fly about 1 kilometre away. The pop can be delayed, so keep flying. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of Mariana County; the tanks sit south of the base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, then shoot enemies until the trophy pops. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs unlocks the Snap Gun and jewelry robberies (green icons), slip in through a jewelry store's back door with the Snap Gun — it stays in your inventory and needs no equipping, and it keeps the job silent. Find the safe-code note in the back room and loot the safe; Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good first target. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe), tail a security van to a bank: the guard opens the vault, and you rob it with your partner (hold Right to hand off a bag). Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000 after his 2 Payday Loan robberies. You get a 4-star wanted level instantly, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles; each bank pays up to $205,000. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — the bank-vault job for Maximum Withdrawal counts automatically, or do it earlier by blocking an armored truck near a bank, blowing its back door with a sticky bomb and escaping the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are sold from the back of Yasmani's shop. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the map by visiting every part of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly a slow, wide route over the whole state and watch the fog lift area by area. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs — 39 operations exist in total, and all of them are needed for 100% completion. Operations show as yellow icons near their locations; track them at Progress, then Gangs. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Honest answer: no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet — PowerPyx lists its method as unknown, and this guide marks it unconfirmed rather than guessing. The description points to enjoying a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so the beachfront bars there are the natural place to look, but no walkthrough has verified a specific trigger. This guide is a static offline bundle with no update mechanism, so the method is listed here as unconfirmed according to the sources it draws on. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide (method unknown).

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in south Vice City — you need the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs — then drive straight through the showroom window. The pop can be delayed. It is a nod to the classic GTA III showroom moment. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob the Kingpin Bowling alley in Port Gellhorn (a gang operation) — buy sticky bombs at Ammu-Nation first. There are 3 valuables inside: a luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and a safe in the north-east hallway to blow with sticky bombs. The trophy pops after you escape the police, and the robbery icon respawns later, so it is not missable. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time (check Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength). After Chapter 2, Coffee Break, get a gym membership and work out together — call your partner and the other one trains automatically — or use home workouts after the story. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Build up 500 actions that affect your criminal profile — click the trophy on PlayStation to see your count. Turn on notifications at Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile so you can see what counts. Profiles range from Professional (stealth and clean play) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho and Irredeemable, which is permanent — so avoid Irredeemable. It comes passively across a full playthrough. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Honest answer: no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet — PowerPyx lists its method as unknown, and it is believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue. This guide marks it unconfirmed rather than guessing, and it is a static offline bundle with no update mechanism, so do not expect a later update to this guide. Do not trust a walkthrough that claims a confirmed method without a source. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide (method unknown).

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Honest answer: no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet — PowerPyx lists its method as unknown, and it is believed to be tied to a UFO questline. Keep an eye out for strange lights and unexplained events while exploring Leonida, but treat any claimed method as unconfirmed until a published guide verifies it. This guide is a static offline bundle with no update mechanism, so the method is listed here as unconfirmed according to the sources it draws on. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide (method unknown).

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Honest answer: no published guide has confirmed how this trophy unlocks yet — PowerPyx lists its method as unknown, and it is believed to involve knocking enemies over while driving a motorcycle. Melee attacks from a moving bike are the natural thing to try, but no walkthrough has verified the trigger. This guide marks it unconfirmed rather than guessing, and it is a static offline bundle with no update mechanism. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide (method unknown).

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer, rob banks and Payday Loans stores, then bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 total is cumulative across the whole game. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in the game — guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn through it. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty stores, 11 tattoo parlours and 15 electronics stores to spend in. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages for $160,000 in total — the 4 story garages do not count. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses); buy them through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), the Scooter Bros app lets you register stolen vehicles, which are then delivered to you anywhere. Buy garages first — each one adds registration spots — then drive to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray plus Register. Early on only vehicles without trackers can be registered; from Chapter 3, standard-tracker cars work at any Pay 'n' Spray. Use cheap cars and bikes. Source: PowerPyx trophy guide.

roadmap.title: Story — 60 to 80 hours
roadmap.text: Finish the 5-chapter story in one playthrough. Do optional missions as they appear, and scan vehicles and study animals during the story — that progress counts even before the checklist is visible. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter: there are 15 manual save slots plus 1 autosave, and there is no mission replay.

roadmap.title: 100% checklist — about 100 hours
roadmap.text: After the story the checklist unlocks at Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. You need any 100 optional missions (200 to 300-plus exist), any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations, 15 of 18 card sets, all 8 large bank jobs, all 39 gang operations and all 15 Target Decks. Only 70 of 80 challenges are needed.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup — about 10 hours
roadmap.text: Finish the 8 counting stranger strands and mop up the miscellaneous trophies: activities, robberies, money and exploration. Difficulty is about 4 out of 10 and the platinum takes around 200 hours in total (Push Square says up to 300-plus). There are no online trophies and none are glitched.

tips: Cheats disable trophies AND saving — never use them on a trophy run.
There are no difficulty settings, so play at your own pace.
Free-roam continues after the story, so almost nothing is missable — except possibly Positive Mental Attitude (meditate in Chapter 1).
Scan vehicles with WAiNK (hold Up, then R1) and study animals with binoculars (L1 weapon wheel, zoom with Up, hold R1) whenever you pass them.
